lead_editorial.title: Dawaon ke daam par Supreme Court ke sawaal jaayaz hain — ab Centre ko thos jawab dena hoga
lead_editorial.summary: Rs 15 ki drip line Rs 250 mein, aur hospital mein dawaon par 100 se 200 guna tak markup — court ke saamne rakhe gaye yeh udaharan bataate hain ki sasti dawa ka vaada aam mareez tak poori tarah nahi pahunch raha.
body: Mangalvaar ko Supreme Court ki Justice Vikram Nath aur Justice Sandeep Mehta ki bench ne dawaon ki keemat par jo tippaniyan kin, woh kisi bhi sarkar ke liye asahaj hain. ANI ki report ke mutabik bench ne poocha ki poora system manufacturers ki madad karta kyun dikhta hai, National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority ko 'totally defunct' kaha, aur ek commercial hospital mein dawaon par 100 se 200 guna markup par sawaal uthaya. Yachika mein daava hai ki lagbhag 82% dawaen DPCO, 2013 ki scheduled list se baahar hain, yaani unki shuruaati keemat par seedha niyantran nahi hota.

Centre ki taraf se Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati ne kaha ki India mein dawaon ki keemat duniya mein sabse kam mein se hai, aur sarkar policy ki lagataar samiksha karti hai. Yeh daava apni jagah sahi ho sakta hai — India generic dawaon ka bada supplier hai. Lekin bench ka jawab bhi utna hi wazandaar tha: sasti ya mehngi ka paimana desh ki kam per capita income se tay hona chahiye, na ki doosre deshon se tulna se.

Hamari raay mein asli mudda keemat ka nahi, kami-beshi ka hai. Jab ek hi cheez thok mein kuch rupaye ki aur mareez ke bill mein kai guna mehngi ho, toh sawaal regulation ki dhaar par uthta hai. Hospitals ki daleel — 24 ghante ka infrastructure, nakli dawaon se bachav, operational kharch — sunne layak hai, par isse dawaon par behisaab margin ko jaayaz nahi thehraya ja sakta. Iska saaf hal hai: kharch ka hisaab alag dikhe, aur dawa ka markup ek tay seema mein rahe.

Bench ne order surakshit rakh liya hai. Faisla jo bhi ho, Centre ko court ke intezaar ke bina hi trade margin rationalisation ko tez karna chahiye, NPPA ko zaroori sansadhan aur adhikaar dene chahiye, aur generic prescription ko badhava dena chahiye. Ilaaj ka kharch aaj bhi kai parivaron ko karz mein dhakelta hai; dawa ka bill us bojh ka sabse bada hissa na bane, yeh sunishchit karna sarkar ki zimmedari hai.

stories.title: Cyclone Arnab ne Yanam ke paas Andhra coast par landfall shuru kiya: tez hawa, ped ukhde, kai ilaakon mein bijli gul
stories.summary: IMD ke mutabik landfall area mein 125–135 km/h ki hawa aur 150 km/h tak ke jhonke; 1.5 se 2.5 meter tak storm surge se nichle ilaakon mein paani bharne ka khatra.
body: Bay of Bengal se utha 'very severe' Cyclone Arnab Budhvaar tadke Andhra Pradesh ke coast se takraana shuru ho gaya. Andhra Pradesh CMO ke hawaale se ANI ne bataya ki landfall ki prakriya Kakinada ke paas Yanam mein shuru hui aur iske subah 4 baje tak poora hone ki ummeed thi. Reuters ki report ke mutabik IMD ne landfall area mein agle chaar ghante tak 125–135 km/h ki lagataar hawa aur 150 km/h tak ke jhonkon ki chetavani di, jiske baad hawa dheere-dheere kam hogi. IMD ne 1.5 se 2.5 meter tak ke storm surge se nichle ilaakon mein paani bharne ki aashanka bhi jataayi.

Reuters ne CM office ke hawaale se bataya ki kai jagah ped ukhad gaye hain aur bijli supply baadhit hui hai. Daily Pioneer ki live report ke mutabik Mangalvaar raat Yanam ke Savithri Nagar mein samundar ka paani 3–4 feet tak chadh gaya aur ek relief camp ki neeche ki manzil mein paani bhar gaya, jiske baad logon ko upar ki manzil par le jaaya gaya. Isi report mein Mangalvaar ko Visakhapatnam ke Mangalapalem mein gire hue bijli ke taar ki chapet mein aane se ek 65 varshiya vyakti ki maut ki khabar di gayi; Reuters ki report mein landfall ke samay tak kisi maut ka zikr nahi tha.

Prashasan ki taiyari badi hai. ANI ke mutabik rajya ne 2,199 cyclone shelters chinhit kiye, 2,360 garbhvati mahilaon ko pehle hi aspataalon mein pahunchaya, aur 12 NDRF va 10 SDRF teams tainat kin. Bijli bahaali ke liye 8,400 se zyada karmchaari lagaye gaye hain. Pioneer ke mutabik Real Time Governance authority ne logon se Budhvaar subah 9 baje tak gharon mein rehne ko kaha hai, aur Telangana ke chaar zilon mein IMD ne Budhvaar ke liye red alert jaari kiya hai.

stories.title: Dawaon ke daam par Supreme Court ka Centre se sawaal — 'system manufacturers ki madad kyun kar raha hai?'; order surakshit
stories.summary: Justice Vikram Nath aur Justice Sandeep Mehta ki bench ne NPPA ko 'totally defunct' kaha aur hospitals mein dawaon par 100–200 guna markup par sawaal uthaye.
body: Supreme Court ne Mangalvaar ko dawaon ki keemat se jude do petitions par sunvaai ke dauraan Centre se kade sawaal kiye. ANI ki report ke mutabik yachikakarta Kishan Chand Jain ka kehna hai ki lagbhag 82% dawaen DPCO, 2013 ki scheduled category se baahar hain, isliye unki shuruaati keemat tay nahi hoti. Yachika mein non-scheduled dawaon ki keemat ka niyantran, medical devices par price cap aur generic prescription ko anivarya karne ki maang ki gayi hai.

Bench ne National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority ko 'totally defunct' bataya aur ek udaharan diya jismein retailer Rs 15 mein kharidi drip line Rs 250 mein bechta hai. Justice Mehta ne poocha ki cancer dawaon par profit margin cap karne mein itna samay kyun laga. Hospitals ki taraf se senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi ne infrastructure aur operational kharch ki daleel di, par ANI ke mutabik bench ne kaha ki hospital 'dacoity' ke sahare nahi chal sakte.

Centre ki taraf se ASG Aishwarya Bhati ne kaha ki India mein dawaon ki keemat duniya mein sabse kam mein se hai aur policy ki lagataar samiksha hoti hai. Bench ne jawab diya ki affordability ko desh ki kam per capita income ke hisaab se dekhna hoga. Sunvaai ke baad court ne apna order surakshit rakh liya.

editorial.title: Arnab ka landfall ho gaya, ab bijli, paani aur rozi ki bahaali hi asli kasauti hai
body: Cyclone Arnab ke saamne Andhra aur Odisha ki taiyari dikhi — shelters, garbhvati mahilaon ko pehle aspataal, hazaron naavon ko kinare laana. Lekin jaise hamne kal kaha tha, landfall ke baad ke din zyada mushkil hote hain. Ped aur khambhe girne se bijli, peene ka paani aur sanchar sabse pehle tootte hain.

Hamari raay mein ab sarkar ko teen cheezon par dhyaan dena chahiye: bijli ki tez bahaali, jahan 8,400 se zyada karmchaariyon ki tainati ek achhi shuruaat hai; nichle ilaakon mein paani nikalne aur beemariyon se bachav ka intezaam; aur fasal va naavon ke nuksaan ka jald, paardarshi survey taaki kisaanon aur machhuaaron ko muavza samay par mile.

stories.title: Israel exit polls: Netanyahu bloc aur vipaksh dono bahumat se door, Likud sabse badi party; Arab dalon ko record 17–18 seat ka anuman
stories.summary: 120 seat ki Knesset mein bahumat ke liye 61 chahiye. Channel 12 aur 13 ke exit polls mein vipakshi 'change bloc' ko 52–53 aur Netanyahu bloc ko lagbhag 50 seat ka anuman.
body: Israel mein Mangalvaar ko hue Knesset chunav ke exit polls kisi bhi khemme ko saaf bahumat nahi de rahe. Ynetnews ke mutabik Channel 12 ne vipakshi bloc ko 52 aur Channel 13 ne 53 seatein di hain, jabki Netanyahu ke bloc ko dono mein 50. Likud ko 24–25 seat ke saath sabse badi party bataya gaya hai, aur Gadi Eisenkot ki Yashar! ko 22–23. Arab party Joint List aur Ra'am ko milakar 17–18 seat ka anuman hai, jo Jerusalem Post ke mutabik ek record hai aur unhe coalition ki baatcheet mein ahem bana sakta hai.

Jerusalem Post ke mutabik Central Elections Committee ne raat 10 baje poll band hone tak 77.7% turnout bataya — 2022 se 7.1 point zyada. Eisenkot ne Netanyahu mein 'poori tarah vishwas ki kami' ki baat kahi aur sarkar badalne ka iraada jataaya, jabki Yair Lapid ne Netanyahu bloc ki 'karaari haar' ka daava kiya. Eisenkot pehle hi Netanyahu ke neeche, yahan tak ki rotation sarkar mein bhi, kaam karne se inkaar kar chuke hain.

Exit polls aakhri nateeje nahi hain. Ynetnews ke mutabik 6.5 lakh se zyada 'double-envelope' votes ki alag se jaanch honi hai aur ginti Shukravaar subah tak chal sakti hai; threshold ke kareeb wali parties ki seatein badal sakti hain. Iske baad President Isaac Herzog dalon se salah karke tay karenge ki sarkar banane ka pehla mauka kise mile.

image.alt: Jerusalem mein Israel ki sansad Knesset ki imarat

stories.title: Iran ke saath diplomacy ki ummeed se tel mein halki narmi, par Hormuz se supply ab bhi saamaanya se kaafi kam
stories.summary: Reuters ke mutabik Brent lagbhag $115 aur WTI lagbhag $101 par; Saudi Arabia, Turkey aur Pakistan ne Tehran mein Iranian adhikariyon se baatcheet ki.
body: Kachche tel ki keematon mein Mangalvaar ko halki giravat aayi. The Irish Times mein chhapi Reuters report ke mutabik Brent lagbhag 0.86% girkar $114.81 prati barrel aur WTI $100.88 par tha. Brent pichhle hafte $117 ke upar gaya tha, jo April ke baad ka sabse ooncha star hai.

Report ke mutabik Saudi Arabia, Turkey aur Pakistan ne Somvaar ko Tehran mein Iranian adhikariyon se tanaav kam karne par baatcheet ki, aur Iranian state media ke anusaar chaaron desh shanti aur suraksha par sahyog ki baatcheet jaari rakhne par sahmat hue. Haalanki Iran-samarthit Houthis ke Saudi Arabia par naye hamlon ne shanti ki ummeedon par sawaal bhi khade kiye hain.

ANZ Research ke hawaale se report kehti hai ki Strait of Hormuz se tel ka pravaah saamaanya ka lagbhag 60% hai aur Gulf se crude export lagataar chauthe hafte gira hai. Duniya ki lagbhag paanchvi energy supply aam taur par isi raaste se guzarti hai — India jaise bade aayaatak desh ke liye yeh mehngai aur chalu khaate, dono ke liye ahem hai.

editorial.title: Israel ka bikhra janadesh: badlav ki chaah saaf, par raasta abhi dhundhla
body: Record turnout aur Netanyahu bloc ka bahumat se door rehna batata hai ki matdaata ke ek bade hisse mein badlav ki chaah hai. Lekin vipaksh bhi apne dum par 61 tak nahi pahunchta, aur Arab dalon ki record seaton ke bina koi bhi vikalp mushkil dikhta hai.

Hamari raay mein aakhri ginti tak intezaar zaroori hai, kyunki threshold ke kareeb ki ek-do party poora ganit badal sakti hain. Jo bhi sarkar bane, use yuddh, bandhakon aur arthvyavastha jaise sawaalon par vyapak sahmati chahiye hogi — aur ek aisi coalition jo sabhi nagrikon, Arab matdaataon samet, ka bharosa jeete.

stories.title: US Fed ka faisla aaj raat; GIFT Nifty se Sensex-Nifty ki sapaat shuruaat ka sanket, Jio Platforms aaj 10 baje list hoga
stories.summary: Bazaar Fed se dar 3.75–4% par sthir rehne ki ummeed kar raha hai, par nazar iske tone par hai. Fed ka asar Indian bazaar par Guruvaar ko dikhega.
body: HDFC Sky ki report ke mutabik GIFT Nifty futures Budhvaar ko Indian bazaar ki lagbhag sapaat shuruaat ka sanket de rahe hain. Mangalvaar ko Sensex 8 point girkar 73,598.67 aur Nifty 3 point girkar 22,749.75 par band hua tha, jabki smallcap index 2.7% chadha. Asian bazaar mile-jule rahe — Kospi 3% se zyada aur Nikkei 1.7% chadhe, jabki Shanghai aur Hang Seng gire.

US Federal Reserve ki do din ki meeting ka faisla Budhvaar ko US samay ke hisaab se aayega, yaani Indian bazaar par iska asar Guruvaar ko dikhega. The Rio Times ke mutabik bazaar dar ko 3.75–4.00% par sthir rehne ki ummeed kar raha hai; HDFC Sky ke mutabik traders iske 'hawkish' tone par nazar rakhe hue hain, kyunki oonchi US dar dollar ko mazboot aur Indian shares ko kam aakarshak bana sakti hai.

Upstox ke mutabik Jio Platforms ke shares aaj subah 10 baje NSE aur BSE par list honge. ₹30,213 crore ka yeh IPO poori tarah fresh issue tha aur lagbhag 22 guna subscribe hua tha. (Yeh khabar sirf jaankari ke liye hai, nivesh ki salah nahi.)

stories.title: AI company Anthropic ne Nasdaq IPO ke liye S-1 file kiya; Fortune ke mutabik $1.8–2 trillion valuation ka anuman
stories.summary: Pehli chhamaahi mein revenue $17 billion, par convertible notes ki vajah se $80 billion ka GAAP ghaata; trading November ke beech tak shuru ho sakti hai.
body: Claude AI banane wali Anthropic ne Somvaar ko Nasdaq par listing ke liye apna S-1 prospectus saarvajanik kiya. Fortune ki report ke mutabik company 'ANT' ticker ke saath list hogi aur iska anumanit valuation $1.8 se $2 trillion ke beech hai. Report ke mutabik roadshow filing ke 15 din baad shuru hoga aur trading November ke beech tak shuru ho sakti hai.

Fortune ke mutabik 2026 ki pehli chhamaahi mein company ka revenue $17 billion raha, jo pichhle saal isi avadhi mein $1.3 billion tha; sirf doosri timaahi mein $11.6 billion. Isi avadhi mein $80 billion ka GAAP ghaata dikhaya gaya, jiski badi vajah convertible notes ki fair value mein badlav bataayi gayi hai, jabki adjusted operating income $1.6 billion raha. Report compute aur infrastructure se jude lagbhag $441 billion ke guaranteed commitments ka bhi zikr karti hai.
TheStreet ke mutabik Somvaar ko Anthropic ki filing ne US tech shares mein sentiment ko sahara diya. (Yeh khabar sirf jaankari ke liye hai, nivesh ki salah nahi.)

stories.title: Wall Street: tech rebound se Nasdaq 1.18% chadha, Boeing ke share lagbhag 10% gire
stories.summary: S&P 500 0.6% upar 7,722.60 par, Dow lagbhag sapaat. Is hafte Microsoft, Amazon aur Alphabet ke nateeje.
body: TheStreet ke mutabik Mangalvaar ko US bazaar mein tech shares ki vaapsi dikhi. Nasdaq 1.18% chadhkar 26,477.81 par, S&P 500 0.60% chadhkar 7,722.60 par aur Russell 2000 1.16% upar band hua, jabki Dow Jones lagbhag sapaat 52,377.57 par raha.

Boeing ke share lagbhag 10% gire, kyunki company earnings ummeedon se peeche rahi aur poore saal ka delivery target ghataya. Cintas 7% se zyada gira, report ke mutabik FTC uske $5.5 billion ke UniFirst sauda ko rokne ke liye mukadma karna chahta hai. Doosri taraf SoFi aur Pentair 11% se zyada chadhe, aur GM ne Nasdaq par listing shift karne ki ghoshna ki.

Report ke mutabik Fed ka faisla bazaar ke liye sabse bada nazdeeki trigger hai, aur is hafte Microsoft, Amazon aur Alphabet ke nateeje se pata chalega ki AI infrastructure par bhaari kharch munafe mein badal raha hai ya nahi.

editorial.title: Fed aur tel — India ke bazaar ke liye is hafte ke do bade imtihaan
body: Fed se dar mein badlav ki ummeed kam hai, par uska sandesh — aage dar badhegi ya nahi — dollar, bond yields aur videshi nivesh ke pravaah ko prabhavit karega. Saath hi Brent ka $115 ke aas-paas tikna India ke import bill aur mehngai par seedha dabav hai.

Hamari raay mein yeh samay ghabrahat ka nahi, saavdhani ka hai. Sarkar aur RBI ko tel ke jhatkon se bachav ke liye fuel tax aur rupaye ki sthirata par lachila rukh rakhna chahiye, jabki niveshkon ke liye — yeh salah nahi, sirf yaad dilaana hai — ek din ki hedline par bhaagne ke bajaay lambi soch zyada kaam aati hai.

stories.title: ISRO chief V Narayanan: India ke launch pad do se badhkar chaar honge; Kulasekarapattinam aur Sriharikota ka teesra pad
stories.summary: The Week ke mutabik Tamil Nadu ke Kulasekarapattinam mein SSLV ke liye 2,000 acre ka complex aur Sriharikota mein agli peedhi ke rocketon ke liye teesra launch pad, jiska lakshya lagbhag 2029 hai.
body: The Week ki report ke mutabik ISRO Chairman V Narayanan ne kaha hai ki India apne chalu launch pads ki sankhya do se badhakar chaar karega. Abhi Andhra Pradesh ke Sriharikota mein Satish Dhawan Space Centre ke do pad se PSLV, SSLV, GSLV aur LVM3 launch hote hain.

Naye pads mein Tamil Nadu ke Thoothukudi zile ke Kulasekarapattinam mein lagbhag 2,000 acre ka complex shaamil hai, jo chhote satellites ke liye SSLV par kendrit hoga. Sriharikota mein teesra launch pad bade, agli peedhi ke rocketon ke liye banega, jiska lakshya lagbhag 2029 hai. Report ke mutabik isse maujooda pads bhaari rocketon aur Gaganyaan jaise crewed missions ke liye khaali rahenge.

Narayanan ne yeh bhi kaha ki ISRO ka nijikaran nahi hoga, balki woh Indian startups aur industry ke saath technology saajha karega. Space analyst Girish Linganna ne The Week se kaha ki do pad wale desh ke paas asal mein ek hi pad hota hai jab doosra marammat ya jaanch mein ho.

stories.title: India ki Oscar entry 'Gondhal' ka global trailer jaari, Marathi film 13 November ko saat bhashaon mein release hogi
stories.summary: Santosh Davakhar ki psychological thriller 99th Academy Awards mein Best International Feature Film category ke liye India ki official entry hai.
body: Bollywood Hungama ki report ke mutabik Marathi psychological thriller 'Gondhal' ka global trailer jaari ho gaya hai. Santosh Davakhar ki likhi aur nirdeshit yeh film 13 November ko Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada aur English — saat bhashaon mein duniya bhar ke theatres mein release hogi.

Film 99th Academy Awards mein Best International Feature Film category ke liye India ki official entry hai. Ishita Deshmukh, Kishor Kadam, Yogesh Sohani aur Nishad Bhoir ki mukhya bhoomika wali yeh kahani ek naye vivaahit jode Suman aur Anandrao ki hai. Davakhar ko 56th IFFI mein Best Director ka Silver Peacock mil chuka hai.
Makers ke mutabik film 25 minute ke ek lagataar take se shuru hoti hai, aur yeh saat bhashaon mein global theatrical release paane wali pehli Marathi film hai — yeh daava makers ka hai.

editorial.title: Space race mein raftaar rocket se nahi, launch pad se bhi tay hoti hai
body: Do launch pad wala desh ek haadse ya marammat se mahino peeche ho sakta hai. Chaar pads ka lakshya isliye sirf sankhya nahi, bharosemand launch slot dene ki kshamata hai — jo global commercial satellite bazaar mein sabse zaroori cheez hai.

Hamari raay mein Kulasekarapattinam aur teesre pad ko samay par poora karna, aur private companies ko in suvidhaon tak saaf, nishpaksh pahunch dena hi asli kasauti hogi. Startups ke saath technology saajha karne ka ISRO ka rukh sahi disha mein hai; ab ise samay-seema aur paardarshi niyamon mein badalna chahiye.
